SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE

Harborview Digestive Health (fictional practice)
Gastroenterology note

Patient: Kai Lindgren (fictional)
Synthetic record: SYN-GI-1016

Chief complaint
Bloating and abdominal discomfort after meals.

History of present illness
36-year-old with six months of postprandial bloating and intermittent loose stools, worse with dairy products. No rectal bleeding, no weight loss, no nocturnal symptoms.

Examination
Abdomen soft, mildly distended, non-tender, normal bowel sounds.

Assessment
Postprandial bloating, likely lactose intolerance or irritable bowel syndrome.

Plan
Trial of a lactose-free diet for four weeks. Lactose breath test ordered. Return in six weeks.
